Until end of turn, it becomes a Vehicle artifact ... and it gains crew 2 and "Crash Land - Whenever this Vehicle deals damage, roll a six-sided die. If the result is equal to this Vehicle's mana value, sacrifice this Vehicle, then it deals that much damage to any target."' Live engine ports (portRows, verified 2026-07-17): emit:damage:noncombat:any (family=damage, stem=damage, manner=noncombat, isSelf=true, tier=Amber) and trigger:damage:any:any (family=damage, stem=damage, manner=any, isSelf=true, tier=Green) + emit:rolldice:controlled (stem=dice). combat facet (noncombat vs any-general), recipient (any), and self-source (isSelf=true) are all AST-derivable -> a faithful witness, not a wish. edhrec_rank=17732 (a RANK, not a popularity count) -> source.popularity omitted (not fabricated). The self-sacrifice + die-result threshold are the card-defined loop-breakers behind the AMBER loop_tier; the sacrifice port is projected coarse (emit:sacrifice, stem=null) so it is not modeled as a facted removal port here (would over-claim).

Captain Rex Nebula.note: THE SELF-WATCH TRIGGER - 'Whenever this Vehicle deals damage' - a self-source subscription (isSelf=true). combat=any: a GENERAL damage trigger (no 'combat' qualifier) fires on either combat or noncombat damage (CR 120). Live label trigger:damage:any:any.
'roll a six-sided die' - the roll payoff of the trigger. Live label emit:rolldice:controlled (control=you). Not the witness; the card-defined bridge from the trigger to the damage payoff.

THE SELF-SOURCE DAMAGE EMIT - 'then it deals that much damage to any target' - the Vehicle ('it') is the source (isSelf=true). combat=noncombat: a triggered-ability damage, NOT the combat damage step (CR 120, not CR 510). recipient=any ('any target'). Live label emit:damage:noncombat:any (tier=Amber - 'that much' = die result = mana value, an unknown quantity, and gated by the threshold).

notes: THE WITNESSED EDGE: a damage-dealt emit satisfies a damage-dealt subscription. Manner-feeds: R3.combat=noncombat feeds R1.combat=any because a general trigger fires on either kind (policy:damage-manner-feeds); a noncombat emit would NOT feed a combat-specific trigger (CR 510 vs 120) - the pruned direction.

self-watch guard (reused, confirmed): R1 is self-watching (subject=self); the emit must be the SAME object's own damage. Same-card (R3.subject=self on Captain Rex Nebula) so it feeds - but object identity the operator can't see -> Overlaps floors AMBER. A DIFFERENT card's self-source damage (Brazen Dwarf) never feeds this trigger.
the trigger resolves into the roll: 'Whenever this Vehicle deals damage, roll a six-sided die' - intra-ability causality, GREEN by construction (CR 603.2 -> the roll effect)

the roll leads to the damage payoff: 'If the result is equal to this Vehicle's mana value, sacrifice this Vehicle, then it deals that much damage to any target' - card-defined GREEN, but the intervening-if die-result threshold and the self-sacrifice are the card-defined firability gates that FLOOR the cycle to AMBER (CR 706.2 die result; the sacrifice removes the source, breaking continuity)

match_policy.subject: facet-feeds
match_policy.lattice: combat |= any ; noncombat |= any (a general 'deals damage' trigger accepts either kind; a combat- or noncombat-specific trigger is fed only by an emit of that same kind)
match_policy.desc: a damage-dealt emit feeds a damage-dealt subscription only when the combat facets are compatible: a general trigger (combat=any, CR 120) fires on either combat or noncombat damage; a combat-specific trigger (CR 510) is fed ONLY by a combat emit; a noncombat emit NEVER feeds a combat-specific trigger. Directional on the combat axis (the manner-feeds constraint the combat-damage-modeling blocker named; engine CombatFacetFeeds).

assertions.because: the closing edge E1 is AMBER (self-watch guard) AND the cycle is not firable: the die-result threshold (result == mana value) is an intervening-if gate and the self-sacrifice removes the source (CR 706.2, 603.2) - a finite, gated loop, never a certified GREEN infinite
